system.description:
• Effect: You may found a house or coven of your blood (see Renown in The Arneyan Codex); each season 1d4 sorcerers of your bloodline (1st level) seek you out. While you hold it, your first Wild Surge each day carries no Corruption risk.
  • Whether or not you hold a Seat, once per day you may apply two Metamagic options to a single spell.

rules.value: Once per day you may apply two Metamagic options to one spell. While you hold your Bloodline Seat, your first Wild Surge each day carries no Corruption risk.
